messages:
nina: Heads-up: small feature-flag flip tonight 01:15 UTC for outbound-router. Plan: pin canary to rc7, enable ff outbound_route_opt at 0.1% -> 2% -> 15%. 10m between bumps. Need SRE and product watch.

deploy-bot: Window start=2026-03-22T01:15Z; actions=[pin:outbound-router@rc7, ff:set outbound_route_opt cohorts=[0.1%,2%,15%] intervals=[10m,10m] auto_backoff=true rollback=/ff set outbound_route_opt=off]

sre-oncall: Preflight: run ff-audit, cache-warm, /slo-check --budget=4%. Gate: if p95 > 220ms for 6m OR 5xx_rate > 0.3% for 6m, auto-soft-disable.

omar: product OK as long as we keep pin for 60m after final bump. Add eu-north to early cohort.

nina: config I'm applying: { pin: "outbound-router@rc7", flag: "outbound_route_opt", cohorts: ["0.1%","2%","15%"], intervals: ["10m","10m"], preflight: ["ff-audit","cache-warm"], rollback_cmd: "/ff set outbound_route_opt=off" }

deploy-bot: preflight results: ff-audit=OK, cache-warm=OK, smoke load=OK. Ready.

deploy-bot: pin applied. flag set to 0.1%.

sre-oncall: initial metrics look clean: p50=40ms p95=150ms error_rate=0.01%. watching.

deploy-bot: bumped 0.1% -> 2% at ts=7261241140.

sre-oncall: small p95 rise in eu-north to 260ms for 3m; tracking. If it stays >220ms past 6m we'll disable.

nina: holding next bump until eu-north stabilizes. cancelling scheduled bump.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump canceled; flag stays at 2%.

sre-oncall: eu-north recovered after cache reprime. p95 back to 180ms. Recommend proceed.

deploy-bot: bump to 15% initiated. logs: "ramp reached 15%" ts=7261241160

omar: product confirms. leave pin 60m. I'll draft release note for morning.

sre-oncall: no SLOs hit. monitoring for 30m post-ramp.
